description.fun: Zapdos is said to dwell among thunderclouds, appearing only in thunderstorms and growing stronger when lightning strikes it. Each flap of its glittering wings releases electricity, so it crackles and snaps as it flies. It seems to be based on the thunderbird of Native American legend, and its name adds the Spanish 'dos': it's the second of Kanto's legendary birds, the one for summer.
description.guide: A large, yellow Electric and Flying Legendary Pokémon, one of Kanto's three legendary birds alongside Articuno and Moltres. It is said to appear in thunderstorms and to gain power from lightning. Its Galarian form, from The Crown Tundra, is Fighting and Flying.
description.tagline: A legendary bird that lives in thunderclouds

description.fun: Galar's Zapdos can barely fly, but its powerful legs carry it over mountains at up to 300 km/h, and its kick can wreck a dump truck. Always spoiling for a fight, it seeks out opponents stronger than itself, and the crackle of its feathers rubbing together earned it its Kanto counterpart's name.
